title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
statement: You are given daily prices in a list `nums`. Choose one day to buy and a later day to sell. Return the maximum profit. If no profitable sale exists, return 0.

predict_steps.prompt: After seeing 7 then 1, what is the lowest buy price so far?
predict_steps.hint: Update the minimum when a cheaper day appears.

predict_steps.prompt: Selling at 6 after buying at 1 yields what profit?

viva.question: What is the time cost of finding the best single buy/sell pair in one forward scan?
expected_points: one linear pass tracks the minimum price so far
profit for a sell day is price minus that minimum
the best profit is updated in constant time per day
no nested day-pair loop is required

viva.question: What breaks if prices only fall and you still force a sale?
expected_points: the best profit is zero when every difference is negative
selling at a loss is never required
the minimum keeps moving forward with no profitable sell
returning a negative profit violates the problem

viva.question: Why is remembering the lowest price behind you enough to judge today's sell?
expected_points: the best buy for a sell today is the minimum among prior days
future days are handled when the scan reaches them
a single pass maintains that running minimum
any better buy would contradict the minimum invariant
